name: Ahilud
overview: The Scriptures identify Ahilud as the father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, both of whom held significant administrative roles in the kingdom of Israel. Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, served faithfully as a recorder, a role involving the careful documentation of royal affairs, as noted in 2 Samuel and 1 Kings. Baana, also a son of Ahilud, was entrusted with governing key territories such as Taanach, Megiddo, and Bethshean, demonstrating the family's trusted position in the governance under King David and Solomon. These passages emphasize the importance of faithful service and stewardship in the administration of God's kingdom on earth.
